// diagnostic

L0503

Prefer `{place} {op} …` instead of repeating the left side

What

Prefer `{place} {op} …` instead of repeating the left side

Why

Compound assignment updates a place in one step without restating it

Fix

Write `{place} {op} …`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0503: tests/ui_lint/prefer_compound_assign.warn.

 Fix: write `p.hp -= …`
